# V2-8 — dead controls, dynamic sweep

Generated by `scripts/v2-verify/dead-controls.mjs` (rerun: `scripts/v2-test-lane.sh --wait 3600 --max 3600 -- node scripts/v2-verify/dead-controls.mjs`).
Modes: browser, tauri · 42.9 + 123.1 + 125.7 + 89.8 + 89.4 + 47.3 + 50.9 + 25.8 + 11.2 + 18.5 + 8.9 + 1.0 + 2.2 + 2.2 + 0.9 min · 2026-10-30T13:17Z.

**How this report was made.** The p8-sweep-finish rounds (A root shell, B2 Smoke/Video/hub link/Home, F1 the four Landing roots, N1–N3 --redo, R1/R2 --seed-from, Q1 the leftovers), then p8-sweep-close on the fixes (19190861d probe + Copy style, 07d7af9d5 stamp follow): Z1 (--resume all nine --redo, both modes: the DEAD state, the not-reached states, every stale state), Z2 (--seed-from Z1 with the walker fixes ed05eb924/8a69f1cfc), and four --replay shards (browser: canvas Smoke › panel-tab-layers and the Landing h1 state, 0 errors; tauri: the Reels tile and Add interaction states). Z1 was corrected to the rule 8a69f1cfc now records itself (a failed walk is not redone). Error groups drawn only by shards from before a fix are listed apart under Fixed since; the three states behind a per-Mac view switch (zoom pill, Inspector Advanced fold) are explained, after Z2 and a --replay found the control absent on a fresh load.

A control is judged once per mode, in the first state that shows it. Effect = any of: DOM change above the idle noise floor (`dom(n)`), aria state, URL, a new popup/menu/sheet/toast, new or removed controls, a studio request (`net`), a focus move to another region, `window.open`, a blocked external navigation, a native `invoke` (Tauri mode). None = **DEAD**. Repeated per-row controls are sampled (2 per family, 12 options per list).

Home in the browser mode is a developer surface only (the app always opens Home in its own webview, with a native bridge); its rows are kept for completeness.

## Errors (0 distinct)

None.
Fixed since (not counted): 4 error groups drawn only by shards crawled before the fix — a shard on the fix that drew one again would count it above.

- console.error ×19 `Access to fetch at 'http://localhost:N/_health' from origin 'http://localhost:N' has been blocked by CORS policy: No 'Ac` — fixed in 19190861d: the loading cap probes the canvas origin with mode: no-cors (an opaque answer = the listener is up), so it no longer throws on the missing CORS header. Test: apps/studio/test/p8-sweep-close-canvas-probe.test.ts › a live cross-origin canvas listener is "compile", not "server"
- console.error ×19 `Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FAILED` — fixed in 19190861d: the loading cap probes the canvas origin with mode: no-cors (an opaque answer = the listener is up), so it no longer throws on the missing CORS header. Test: apps/studio/test/p8-sweep-close-canvas-probe.test.ts › a live cross-origin canvas listener is "compile", not "server"
- http 400 ×3 `POST /_api/edit-op` — fixed in 07d7af9d5: an edit-op built from the tree of before a stamp follows the stamped id (client/stamp-follow.js), so a second Layers click on a just-stamped object is not refused. Test: apps/studio/test/p8-sweep-close-stamp-follow.test.tsx › Hide, then Show again before the canvas re-posts its tree: the second op names the stamped id
- console.error ×3 `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400 (Bad Request)` — fixed in 07d7af9d5: an edit-op built from the tree of before a stamp follows the stamped id (client/stamp-follow.js), so a second Layers click on a just-stamped object is not refused. Test: apps/studio/test/p8-sweep-close-stamp-follow.test.tsx › Hide, then Show again before the canvas re-posts its tree: the second op names the stamped id
